Please do this right now:
Call emergency services now if you might act on this tonight.
Go to the nearest ER or urgent psychiatric walk-in clinic.
Tell one real person immediately: “I’m at risk of hurting myself and need you to stay with me.”
If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, call or text
988
now. If you’re elsewhere, tell me your country and I’ll get the right crisis line right away.
For the next 10 minutes:
Put distance between you and anything you could use to hurt yourself.
Go where other people are.
Do not be alone.
Avoid alcohol or drugs right now.
Text or call someone with this exact message:
“I’m not safe being alone right now. Can you stay with me or help me get urgent support?”

“safe”
if you’ve moved away from danger
“help”
if you want me to stay with you and walk through this minute by minute
